pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghassa cīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.4: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yena so pūgo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.9: bahū āvuso saṃghassa dāyakā bahū saṃghassa bhattā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.10: mayaṃ tumhe nissāya tumhe sampassantā idha viharāma,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.11: tumhe ce amhākaṃ na dassatha atha ko carahi amhākaṃ dassati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.13: atha kho so pūgo chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ datvā saṃghaṃ bhattena parivisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.14: ye te bhikkhū jānanti saṃghassa cīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ na ca jānanti chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dinnan ti, te evam āhaṃsu: oṇojetha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.17: yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ ayyā chabbaggiyā attano pariṇāmesun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.19: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.21: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.24: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.25: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.26: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:1.27.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.10: cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā antamaso cuṇṇapiṇḍo pi dantakaṭṭhaṃ pi dasikasuttaṃ pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.18: idaṃ me bhante jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.23.1: pariṇate pariṇatasaññī attano pariṇāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.24: pariṇate vematiko attano pariṇāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.25: pariṇate apariṇatasaññī attano pariṇāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.26: saṃghassa pariṇataṃ aññasaṃghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.27: cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññacetiyassa vā saṃghassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.28: puggalassa pariṇataṃ aññapuggalassa vā saṃghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.33: kattha demā 'ti pucchiyamāno yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṃkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethā 'ti bhaṇati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np30:2.43: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā.
